scores.reasons: Website is a photo portfolio with no offer, phone link, form or schema - almost everything is missing; a 1946-founded general contractor could have real budget but the Gmail contact and unmaintained site suggest a very small operation; the rebuild is a moderate job, not a quick fix; evidence is direct from the site (homepage, /info, robots.txt) though no financial or review data exists.

caveats: Review ratings and counts come from Birdeye's aggregated third-party profiles (which mirror Google data) because Google Maps could not be read directly in this session; treat counts as approximate and possibly stale.
No Google Business Profile claim status was verified for any business except DGC Roofing, whose Birdeye profile states it is claimed.

Cramar Electric's New Brunswick listing carries no address and no reviews while the cramarelectric.com company is based in Howell NJ; the match between listing and website is an inference, not confirmed.
Carter & Sons Roofing's website returned HTTP 403 to every request; website_review fields marked unknown/false reflect that failure, not necessarily the real customer experience.
Mustakas's batch category is 'Roofing & renovations' but its own site shows snow removal, excavation, masonry, concrete, pavers and kitchen/bath work - no roofing content was visible.
data_gaps: Google Maps listings could not be opened for ratings/review counts; Birdeye aggregate profiles were used instead.

electricalmakeover.com sits behind a Cloudflare managed challenge that never cleared, so no page text, schema or form fields could be inspected; hours (Mon-Fri 8-7) and licence 34EB01624400 come from search snippets of the site rather than pages I read.
cramarelectric.com was blocked in the browser (net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_CLIENT), so no desktop or phone screenshots and no form verification were possible; content came from fetched HTML.
cartersonsroofing.com returned 403 Forbidden for the homepage and New Brunswick page in both the browser and a plain fetch; site content could not be read.
Manta's page for Maul Electric returned 403, so its phone number and address come from the search snippet, not the page itself.
No phone numbers could be confirmed for B & B Electrical Contracting; a similarly named firm in Highland Park appeared in one yellowpages snippet but I could not verify it is the same business.
No Google reviews, hours or claim status were found for Mustakas Contracting, B & B Electrical Contracting or Maul Electric.
